How do I start a return or an exchange?
To start a return, you’ve got two options:
UK customers: Use the online returns portal at the provided link, search for “Chillys,” fill in your details, and choose your return method.
Outside the UK: Post unused items in saleable condition to the listed returns address, ideally with a tracked/signed-for service.
We don’t offer free returns, so postage costs are covered by you. Bundles must be returned in full, with all items unused. Engraved products can’t be returned unless they’re faulty or damaged.
For damaged or faulty items, don’t send them back—keep the product and reach out to our Customer Service team via the support widget so we can review photos and help from there. That process also applies if there’s an issue with an item in a bundle.
